column3: Action to be taken during rain

column2: • Operate the pumps as and when required.

column3: • Check the water disposal at the outlet.

column2: • Check the hose pipe and ensure that it is intact.
column3: • Ensure the movement of traffic in the subway.

column2: • Ensure the traffic movement without hindrance.
column3: • Caution the two wheelers riding in subway.

column2: • Monitor the water level and to inform the higher level officer and submit a report every two hours.
column3: • Do not to allow senior/ disabled people to cross the subway.

column2: • Photograph the subway to ascertain its status and to ensure traffic movement and share through WhatsApp.
column3: • Close the subway if water in the subway is above the danger mark normally more than 3 feet at the lowest level.
